articles.summary: PennyMac Mortgage Investment Trust (NYSE: PMT) announced today that its Board of Trustees declared a cash dividend of $0.40 per common share of beneficial interest for the second quarter of 2026. This dividend will be paid on July 24, 2026, to common shareholders of record as of July 9, 2026. About PennyMac Mortgage Investment Trust PennyMac Mortgage Investment Trust is a mortgage real estate investment trust (REIT) that invests primarily in residential mortgage loans and mortgage-related assets
articles.title: PennyMac Mortgage Investment Trust Declares Second Quarter 2026 Dividend for Its Common Shares
